definitions.explanation: The point at which excitement, tension, activity, or emotion reaches its highest level. Can also refer literally to the highest tide.

examples.japanese: {盛|も}り{上|あ}がりが{最高潮|さいこうちょう}に{達|たっ}した。
{試合|しあい}は{最高潮|さいこうちょう}を{迎|むか}えた。
{祭|まつ}りの{最後|さいご}に{興奮|こうふん}は{最高潮|さいこうちょう}に{達|たっ}し、{花火|はなび}が{打|う}ち{上|あ}げられた。
examples.english: At the end of the festival, the excitement reached its peak and fireworks were launched.

notes:
Literally means "highest tide" ({最高|さいこう} + {潮|ちょう}), used figuratively to describe the peak or climax of any rising intensity — excitement, tension, popularity, conflict, etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最高潮|さいこうちょう}に{達|たっ}する: to reach the peak/climax
- {最高潮|さいこうちょう}を{迎|むか}える: to reach the climax
- {興奮|こうふん}が{最高潮|さいこうちょう}に: excitement at its peak
- {緊張|きんちょう}が{最高潮|さいこうちょう}に: tension at its height

SIMILAR WORDS:
- クライマックス: climax (loanword) — used more for narrative/story structure
- {頂点|ちょうてん}: summit, peak — more general, used for achievement and position
- {絶頂|ぜっちょう}: pinnacle, peak — stronger intensity, can sound more dramatic
- ピーク: peak (loanword) — more casual, used for statistics and trends
